content: UTF-8 chunk boundary corruption: multi-byte chars (CJK=3 bytes, emoji=4 bytes) split across read buffers cause U+FFFD replacement. Fix: use TextDecoder with stream:true option — persistent instance per terminal, call decode(chunk, {stream:true}). On Rust side: emit raw Vec<u8> bytes, NOT String::from_utf8_lossy(). ANSI escape sequences: xterm.js parser handles split sequences correctly if fed raw bytes.
